_comment: Fictional persona for SOH-221 stress data. No real people.
name: Liam O'Connor
about_me: I'm Liam, a software engineer at Ford on the Ford Pro team. On the side I'm building a map of reliable EV chargers. I'm looking for a PM co-builder and access to charging data.
goals: Ship the EV charger reliability map beta

debriefs.text: Lucia Ferraro, recruiter on my team, said Ford is hiring new-grad embedded engineers again.
Met Hye-jin Park, a Ross junior who wants EV product experience. She could run user interviews.
Nate Okonkwo, PM at Rivian on charging software, said Rivian has uptime data but can't share it.
Irene Kovacs at Detroit's Office of Mobility Innovation offered city charger data.
